name: Joypad-OS GameCube Adapter (HID)
notes: joypad-os's emulation of the Wii U GameCube adapter, not Nintendo's own device: the 70-byte report descriptor joypad-os serves (joypad-ai/joypad-os src/usb/usbd/descriptors/gc_adapter_descriptors.h). It declares a Game Pad application with report 0x11, five output bytes after its ID, report 0x21, 36 input bytes after its ID, and report 0x13, one output byte after its ID. The strings are the ones joypad-os serves, Nintendo Co., Ltd. and WUP-028. Nintendo's adapter declares a different 214-byte descriptor, which gamecube-adapter-hid carries, and gamecube-adapter is the working persona.

layout.note: joypad-os's emulation of the WUP-028 adapter. nintendo/gamecube-adapter-hid carries Nintendo's own descriptor.
